_comment: Memory-only cases for scripts/bench.py --coding. Gold keys are memories in this file. A paraphrase shares no content word with its gold text. forbid_win must not rank above gold (the old decision must not win). never must not appear in the delivered results. Hook events are what automatic recall sees. No document sections and no code outlines.

memories.title: quartz_queue.rs drops claims
memories.summary: src/jobs/quartz_queue.rs loses a claimed row when the worker panics mid-update.
memories.reason: The claim update and the panic share one transaction.

fields.symptom: A claimed row in src/jobs/quartz_queue.rs disappears after a panic.
fields.cause: The claim update and the panic share one transaction.
fields.fix: Commit the claim before the worker continues.

memories.title: Reserve work with quartz_claim
memories.summary: Workers call quartz_claim before editing a job row.
memories.reason: Two workers were taking the same row.

fields.context: The job table allowed two updates at once.

memories.title: Moved quartz claim in the worker
memories.summary: error: the worker panicked after moving quartz claim before the row update finished
memories.reason: The row guard is moved into the assertion.

fields.symptom: error: the worker panicked after moving quartz claim before the row update finished
fields.cause: The row guard is moved into the assertion.
fields.fix: Borrow the guard until the update returns.

memories.title: One worker takes the next job
memories.summary: A solitary process locks the pending unit so a second process cannot grab it.

memories.title: Amber claims rows in batches
memories.summary: On feature/amber the worker claims ten rows at once from the job table.
memories.reason: The amber experiment reduces round trips.

fields.context: Round trips dominated the amber branch.
fields.consequences: Each amber claim covers ten rows.

memories.title: Birch claims rows one by one
memories.summary: On feature/birch the worker claims one row at a time from the job table.
memories.reason: The birch experiment keeps locks short.

fields.context: Long locks stalled the birch branch.
fields.consequences: Each birch claim covers one row.

memories.title: Use a table lock for jobs
memories.summary: Jobs are claimed with a table lock so two workers cannot run one job.
memories.reason: The first design used one lock for the whole table.

fields.consequences: The table lock blocks every worker.

memories.title: Use a row skip lock for jobs
memories.summary: Jobs are claimed with a row skip lock so two workers cannot run one job.
memories.reason: The table lock blocked every worker.

fields.context: The table lock blocked every worker.
fields.consequences: A worker locks only its own row.

memories.title: Wharf retries use jitter
memories.summary: The wharf service retries with full jitter after a connection reset.
memories.reason: A fixed delay synchronized every client.

fields.consequences: Each wharf retry waits a random time.

memories.title: Keep invoice fonts embedded
memories.summary: Invoice templates embed font files so a render does not fetch them.
memories.reason: A missing font changed the layout.

fields.context: A render fetched fonts from the network.

memories.title: Cap preview pages at twenty
memories.summary: A preview renders at most twenty pages.

fields.exceptions: A full export has no page cap.

memories.title: Pin harbor-cli at 1.4.2
memories.summary: Scripts call harbor-cli 1.4.2 for the config flag.

memories.title: Zephyr vault passphrase rotation
memories.summary: Rotate the zephyr vault passphrase every monday using the quarry checklist.
memories.reason: The quarry team owns that vault.
